variety: Spanish phrases that are identical in Argentina and Mexico, so either female voice may read them. Argentine accent is welcome but not required.
pronunciation_note: English-style respelling, capitals mark the stressed syllable. Argentine accent: "ll" and "y" sound like "sh".

phrases.when: Often the first thing you hear. Do not confuse “derecho” (straight) with “derecha” (right).
Usually comes after “todo derecho”. The “z” sounds like an “s” in Argentina.
Same shape as “A la izquierda”. Point with your hand while you listen.
